about: Scoped missing evidence. kind is photo, map or measurement. Received evidence requires source inspection before it is answered. These requests do not block unrelated work.

requests.ask: From the Calle Loira and Pintor Dalí bend, photograph east along the resort wall with both road edges in frame. From outside the Juan Gris grille, photograph the wall square-on with the wall foot and top, then turn to photograph the opposite frontage and grass edge.
requests.why: Locate the wall ends, road-side grass and openings, and obtain a registered view of the wall and the opposite frontage.

requests.ask: Side-on photo from the lawn path of the northwest tiled stair and curved wall, plus a view from the top looking down, showing the floor joins and stair ends.
requests.why: Resolve the stair/terrace position and height transition without guessing concealed limits.

requests.ask: A dated, scaled plan or clear aerial showing ground-wall corners and the Isabel-side access edges. Where roofs or vegetation hide the ground, we need ground-level photos instead.
requirements: Georeference the source with scale and registration controls
Distinguish ground walls from projecting roofs
requests.why: Existing aerials and elevated photos do not establish every concealed patio boundary or access width. This flags those limits only; visible pool and facade work can continue.

requests.ask: Ground-level photos from the north pool's west path looking south at the two white patio walls with brown gates (south of the hibiscus hedge, west of the station roof), showing each gate's foot, the wall ends and a known width such as a door leaf.
requirements: Wall feet and door sills visible
One photo square to each wall
Note which house each patio belongs to
requests.why: From the roof the door feet are hidden by planting, so the gates' positions along the walls and the walls' heights cannot be cast through the solved station camera.

requests.ask: Two or three photos from the north pool lawn, standing on the grass about 3-5 m from the north path, looking north at the north row's patios: the white plinth wall with its three white steps, the hedges, and the house fronts with the awnings behind. Include the whole width from the alley arch (west) to the iron gate by Calle Isabel (east).
requirements: At least two positions a few metres apart
House door sills visible where possible
requests.why: The roof station sees these patios from one place, so depth near the house fronts is uncertain by 1-3 m. A second station gives a measured position for the patio front and the house fronts.

requests.ask: Stand at the north tip of the round palm island and photograph north-west along the central row of bays and palms with the long white wall in frame; then the same from the north end of the row looking back south-east to the island.
requests.why: the central bay row is rotated in the model; two opposed ground views along it, with the wall as a known line, fix its position (one camera fixes direction only)

requests.ask: From the middle aisle, photograph square-on to the west row of angled bays and the hedge behind them, then along the row in both directions; if there is a path behind the hedge, one photo along it.
requests.why: no photo shows the west side of the car park, its hedge, or whether a footpath runs behind it

requests.ask: Photograph the inner (car-park) face of the long white wall square-on with a person or car for scale, and one along it from each end, showing any kerb or footway at its foot.
requests.why: the wall's height and its car-park side are only seen from the road

requests.ask: From inside the car park at its north end, photograph the barrier, the CALLE DE PICASSO plinth and the road it opens onto, with the end of the long wall in frame.
requests.why: IMG_3130 and IMG_3131 have pins ±5-21 m; which corner the barrier and plinth stand on is not settled
